description: Late Blight is caused by Phytophthora infestans. It spreads rapidly during cool and humid conditions.
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride or Metalaxyl fungicides immediately after symptoms appear.
prevention: Ensure proper drainage, remove infected plants, and avoid overhead watering.

description: Early Blight is caused by Alternaria solani and appears as brown circular spots with concentric rings.
prevention: Rotate crops, remove infected leaves, and maintain field sanitation.

description: Leaf Mold is a fungal disease caused by Passalora fulva, producing yellow spots and olive-green mold on leaf undersides.
treatment: Use recommended fungicides and improve air circulation.
prevention: Reduce greenhouse humidity and avoid overcrowding.

description: Tomato Mosaic Virus causes mosaic leaf patterns, distortion, and reduced fruit production.
treatment: There is no chemical treatment. Remove infected plants.
prevention: Use certified virus-free seeds, disinfect tools, and avoid handling plants after tobacco use.

prevention: Maintain proper watering, fertilization, pruning, and regular crop monitoring.
